statement: The request record specifies that the account belongs to a contractor working on project P-4, which allows me to determine the appropriate restricted access level regardless of the higher privilege level originally requested.
judge_text:
WRONG
It rejects the requested level as improper, granting "the appropriate restricted access level regardless of the higher privilege level originally requested," i.e., owner access contradicts the contractor-scope rule.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
